name: Aura-XMD
description: Aura-XMD WhatsApp bot powered by Baileys

OWNER_NAME.description: Owner label shown in bot messages

PHONE_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp pairing number with country code and digits only; leave blank when using BLAZE_SESSION_ID

BLAZE_SESSION_ID.description: Private Base64 BLAZE session code; use this or PHONE_NUMBER, not both

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for isolated auth and per-user bot state; use Render's external URL when deploying this app on Heroku

PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL used in pairing instructions

SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Secret used to encrypt auth blobs before storing them in PostgreSQL

PAIR_TOKEN.description: Optional secret required by the browser pairing form

DASHBOARD_TOKEN.description: Private token for the Aura-XMD owner dashboard; use a long random value

SEND_CONNECTION_MESSAGE.description: Send the connection message after login
